standard_prerequisites: the descent situation of the chapter: a limit of schemes or algebraic spaces with transition maps and X the limit
the induction principle for spaces etale over the limit
full faithfulness of the colimit functor on perfect objects (descend-homomorphisms lemma)
the gluing lemma for objects with maps over a distinguished square covering
perfect objects of the derived category
core_obligations: Prove that in the descent situation the category of perfect objects of D(O_X) is the colimit of the categories of perfect objects of D(O_{X_i})
proof_roadmap: Fix a quasi-compact quasi-separated U_0 etale over X_0 and induct on the induction principle for the property that the colimit of perfect categories over U_i is equivalent to the perfect category over U
Full faithfulness is already known from the descend-homomorphisms lemma, so only essential surjectivity remains

Induction step for a distinguished square: descent picks perfect E_{U,i} and E_{V,i} on U_i and V_i pulling back to the restrictions of a perfect E on X; by full faithfulness, after enlarging i, their restrictions to the overlap are isomorphic compatibly with the pullback identifications
The gluing lemma produces a perfect E_i on X_i with a map to the direct image of E whose adjoint pullback is isomorphic to E
Base case X_0 affine: this is the schemes case, transferred along the equivalence of the derived category with the small etale derived category and the descend-perfect translation lemma
difficulty_reason: H2: a full induction argument with a gluing step; every ingredient is either proved earlier in the chapter or quoted from the schemes case, and the source carries all compatibilities.
